description: This file defines classes and functions for VRB-to-PRB resource mapping in 5G NR resource allocation, including configurations for interleaved and non-interleaved mappings, with functions to create specific configurations based on 3GPP TS38.211 specifications.

classes.name: non_interleaved_mapping
classes.description: Class for handling VRB-to-PRB mapping in non-interleaved resource allocation.

classes.name: interleaved_mapping
classes.description: Class for handling VRB-to-PRB mapping in interleaved resource allocation.

methods.name: vrb_to_prb
methods.description: Converts VRB index or interval to corresponding PRB index or interval.

methods.name: prb_to_vrb
methods.description: Converts PRB index to corresponding VRB index.

methods.name: vrb_to_crb
methods.description: Converts VRB bitmap to CRB bitmap.

methods.name: vrb_to_crb_indices
methods.description: Gets CRB indices from VRB bitmap.
